Hi Sarah — thanks for the note. Quick answers below and some follow-ups: 

- HubSpot owner: Marcus Lin (cc) will own the property mapping and the ingestion workflow.
- Fields we want: first_name, last_name, email, company, job_title, country, lead_source (value: "Sage Nov 2026"), product_interest (multi-select), consent_timestamp, consent_text, us_opt_in (boolean).
- Retention: Redwood prefers full raw export retained by LeadSync for 30 days; the copy that lands in HubSpot should not store any scanned badge ID numbers (PII redaction: remove badge_id, scanner_serial).

Marcus - LeadSync needs the CSV header names and the HubSpot property internal names. I'm attaching an initial property map (hubspot-property-map.csv) and the latest spec from LeadSync. Please confirm and add any missing props.

Sarah — for consent, we use the short text in the sample_consent_text.txt attachment. Can you confirm Sage Events is comfortable with that wording on the kiosk? It covers marketing emails and booth follow-up within the US. If we have EU attendees we may need an additional checkbox (GDPR) — not expected in large numbers for this show but worth flagging.

Thanks,
